title: The Genesis & Official Identity
description: The 2016–2017 academic year marked a defining milestone for our association with the official unveiling of the YANTRAM - MESA logo. Setting a high benchmark for campus events, we inaugurated Yantram 2K17 with renowned digital creator and influencer Prajakta Koli (@Mostlysane) joining us as the Chief Guest. Her presence energized the grand launch, establishing YANTRAM as a flagship technical and automotive platform at BVCOE.

title: Expansion
description: Introduction of the first conceptual Auto Expo, bringing local automobile enthusiasts together.

title: Digital Pivot
description: Adapted to the pandemic with virtual design workshops and online CAD competitions, keeping the culture alive.

title: Supercar Era
description: The Auto Expo witnessed a massive upgrade with the inclusion of 600cc+ superbikes and visually tuned supercars.

title: Decade of Horsepower
description: Celebrating the 10th edition. MESA hosts the biggest Auto Expo in Mumbai and MMR region, setting a new benchmark.
